description: A crouched, shirtless man with matted hair and a fur loincloth blows through a long pipe into a fire. The fire heats a stone-rimmed basin holding green ore pieces, and a molten orange stream runs from it into a clay pot. Another figure sits in shadow behind him, and green ore chunks, a stone tool and charcoal lie on the ground. The setting is a dim rock shelter or hut. No text, numbers or frame are visible, and the image is edge to edge.
